x: Our young Belgian friend, Etienne Gailley has left town. In a most charming letter he thanked the Club for all we had done for him during his few months' stay.

Etienne Gailley, who was whisked from our last issue to his native Belgium, visited us early in the year in the uniform of an "umbrella man." He was pleased to tell us that he had met his family again.
Etienne Gailley, perhaps better known as "Steve," is now commissioned in the Belgian Army, and sends his best wishes to his Belgrave friends.
